description.value:
You've got a favored routine you perform repeatedly and have learned how to do so efficiently without risk. Select one of the following actions: Anti-Glitch Response, Let Me Hear You Cheer, or Light Hop. The frequency of the selected action becomes once per 10 minutes, rather than once per day.

Special You can take this feat more than once, selecting a different action each time.

value.value: Anti-Glitch Response, Light Hop, or mascot living hologram heritage
